title: 910 Race 2026 Review: Indonesia's Homegrown Shoe Brand Half Marathon
seo_title: 910 Race 2026 Review | ICE BSD Tangerang Indonesia
meta_description: The 910 Race 2026 (910Nineten Race): October 11 at ICE BSD, Tangerang. 21K, 10K, 5K from Indonesia's own running shoe brand with registration open from IDR 379K.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 at ICE BSD in Tangerang, this 910 Nineten-branded race offers three distances with registration open from IDR 379K. Indonesia's homegrown running shoe brand puts on a race at the country's premier exhibition venue.
verdict: The 910 Race is a brand-owned road race from 910 Nineten — one of Indonesia's few homegrown running shoe brands — held at ICE BSD, the country's largest exhibition centre in the BSD City development near Jakarta. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open from IDR 379K-679K (roughly USD 24-43). A shoe-brand race typically means quality race merchandise — expect well-designed tees, finisher medals, and likely product sampling. For Indonesian runners who want to support a local brand or anyone after a well-produced Jakarta-area half marathon, this is a distinctive pick.

sections.heading: 910 Nineten: Indonesia's Running Brand
paragraphs: 910 Nineten is one of Indonesia's few domestic running shoe brands, making this a brand-owned race similar to Decathlon's Kiprun Singapore. [1] ICE BSD is a world-class exhibition venue in BSD City, a planned satellite city southwest of Jakarta, with wide roads and modern infrastructure.

faqs.question: When is the 910 Race 2026?
faqs.answer: 11 October 2026 at ICE BSD, Tangerang, Indonesia. It offers 21.1K, 10K, and 5K. Registration is currently open. 910 Nineten (Indonesian running-shoe brand) organises the event. It's held at ICE BSD (Indonesia Convention Exhibition), BSD City, Tangerang, Banten. [1]
